messages:
maria: Sprint brief 1: landing copy pass for three pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). Must drive webinar signups, demo requests, and clean lead routing. Keep each page scannable with one micro-benchmark.
jon: Agreed. One-sentence hero, 3 benefit bullets, benchmark line, primary CTA = Register Webinar, secondary = Request Demo.
ashley: Two hero options: A) 'Same API. Any deployment. Production SLAs.' B) 'Ship LLM features with predictable performance and enterprise controls.' Prefer A for punch.
maria: Use A but tweak to: 'One API. Any deployment. Production SLAs.' Short and snappy.
kevin: Benchmarks (verbatim one-liners under hero): Hosted 1: '~50 ms median token latency on common open LLMs; transparent $/1k tokens.' Dedicated 1: 'Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput  e.g., ~5k tokens/sec sustained on standard configs.' Private 1: 'Audit-ready: SOC 2, customer-managed VPC, KMS integrations and on-prem options.' Keep numbers rounded.
jon: Benefit bullets: 'Unified API across deployments', 'Predictable unit economics & autoscaling', 'Enterprise-grade controls & audits'.
maria: Webinar CTA copy: 'Register: Live demos + benchmark walkthroughs for Hosted, Dedicated, Private.' Add 'Request Demo' for enterprise.
kevin: Inbound form routing stub (ops):
```
if tier == 'enterprise': route -> sdr-enterprise@redwood.ai; tag='enterprise'
elif needs_private: route -> solutions@redwood.ai; tag='private-interest'
else: route -> selfserve@redwood.ai
if wants_webinar: add_campaign 'launch-webinar-apr'
```
maria: Add 'primary_use_case' field to form to help SDRs. Document routing in Confluence.
ashley: I'll drop three CTA variants and headline A/B into the Website Copy doc and flag favorites by EOD.
marketing-bot: Reminder: webinar reg page live Tue 09:00 PT. @ashley finalize CTAs by Mon 16:00 PT.
kevin: I'll produce one-page benchmark PDFs per mode with methodology and sample prompts and post links.
maria: Final sign-off meeting Mon 10:00 PT. Ping me for blockers. :rocket:
